apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4 Debug
apps.localizedDescription: Touch Mode Always now overrides keyboard/mouse detection for allocation and initial stream routing. Keeps the opt-in native touch with 4:4:4 Windows tablet experiment and desktop HDR color request. Adds bounded profile/routing diagnostics and touch packet submission counters; host digitizer support remains unverified. End the old session and launch a fresh one to test. Existing Metal 4 rendering/effects controls retained. 203 tests passed, zero failures and one hardware skip. Unsigned experimental build.
